about_content:
GuardianSuit ukax machaq, responsive ukat unch'ukiñanitayka Captive Portal plantilla utji OPNsense-taki. Apnaqirinakarux k'achacht'ata mantaña pachani churi ukat apnaqirix saminchawita ukat lurañanakata uñjapacha apnaqañani.

Nayriri lurañanaka:

  • Responsividad ukat unch'ukiñanaka.
  • Walja arunaka.
  • Saminchawita ukat saminaka jasaki mayjt'ayaña.
  • Intuitivo UX ukat WCAG iyawsawimpi.

cookies_content:
Kunas mä cookie qillqatax?

Cookies qillqatanakax jisk'a qillqa archivonakawa, internet navegadorta amuyata paqarinayanaka web laphinaka uñjkasina. Aka cookie archivona utjiki uka yatiyāwinakax uka chiqataw ullataraspa kawkhantix archivotax jutki. Ukhamatwa web laphix jan jikxatkaspati yaqha archivonaka apnaqirita computadorapana utjirinaka.

Cookies archivonakana yatiyāwinaka utjatapatayku web laphix "yatiwa" kunjams apnaqasta ukatxa yatiyāwinaka jumata uñacht'ayañataki askichaspawa jan ukax yanapa churaspa.

Kunatakis cookies qillqatanaka apnaqthan?

Web laphinxa técnicos cookies qillqatanaka apnaqthan, ukanakax web laphi sum irnaqañapataki munatawa. Apnaqthanwa web laphisa machaqachañataki yānakataki ukat navegadonakataki ukanakax juk'ampi apnaqatarakiwa jikxatirinakampi – ukhamat computadorama, tabletama jan ukax telefonoma sum uñacht'ayaspawa ukat amtasiniwa iyawsasiti akachakana ajllita yatiyāwinaka uñacht'ayañataki.

Apnaqirix janiw jaytawkaspa técnicos cookies qillqatanakaru.

Qhaqha pachas cookies qillqatanaka apnaqthan?

Apnaqthanwa utjaskakiri cookies qillqatanaka, ukanakax yānama manqhana utjaskakiwa mā akch'a pachataki jan ukax luq'uypacha chhaqhayatāña pachakamau.

Kuna yatiyāwinakas cookies qillqatanakampi apthapthan?

Cookie tecnologiawimpiru jumata anonimos técnicos yatiyāwinakaki apthapthan, web laphisa sum apnaqañataki.

Janiw khitiytasa uñt'ayañataki yatiyāwinaka apthapktiti. Qawqha yatiyāwiki utjki apnaqirita, jan yaqha yatiyāwinakampi mayachasita, jan uñt'ayasiykiri, IP utjawikiwa kawkhantix apnaqirix mayachasinki.

AKA KATUQAÑA MANQHAN UTJIRI CAMACHINAKA

YATIYĀWINAKAMA P'IQINCHAÑA CAMACHINAKA
